{{Top|leg}}
'''Flame carpet warheads''' were a weapon filled with a flammable chemical. Thick and adhesive, the burning liquid could be scattered across several square kilometers when the warhead was detonated. Once ignited, the liquid burnt anything and everything it came in contact with.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse'', it is spelled "Flame-carpet warhead".
